_meta.description: Middle third of the demo video (Kurt's walkthrough, <= 1:30): find your representative by ZIP, read the evidence, then start from a topic and get matched. Shots in tools/demo/record.mjs (k*).

segments.caption: The whole House on one ring
segments.text: Here's how to read it. In the middle is the whole House. Each coloured dot on the ring is a committee, and every small dot is a member.

segments.caption: Search by name, district or ZIP
segments.text: Say you want your own representative. Click the search bar up top, and type a name, a district, or your ZIP code. Here's 91204.

segments.caption: Lines = what she spends her time on
segments.text: There she is, Laura Friedman, a Democrat from California's 30th. The ring shows only her lines, the topics she spends time on, and her positions are in the right panel.

segments.caption: Every sentence cites a quote
segments.text: Click Open profile for her full page. The summary's written by Muse Spark, and every sentence cites a statement. Click a number to read the quote.

segments.caption: Evidence and changes over time
segments.text: Click a topic, and the right panel shows you the evidence: each vote and statement, and when her position changed.

segments.caption: Start from a topic you care about
segments.text: Now back to Explore. Maybe you care about a topic, not a person. Click Education and Workforce. It opens into its topics, and I'll pick Child Care.

segments.caption: Real bills as yes-or-no questions
segments.text: Now the right panel turns each real bill into a yes-or-no question. Just answer the ones you care about. Three is enough to start.

segments.caption: Who matches you · filter by state
segments.text: Then, below the ring, open Show matches. These members' records line up with yours, and you can narrow it to your state.

segments.caption: Where you agree, and where you differ
segments.text: Click a name, and you'll see exactly which bills you agree on, and where you differ.

segments.caption: az30667176-sudo.github.io/owl
segments.text: That's OWL. Find out who really stands with you.
